title: Object Animation — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea lights
scenes.purpose: Establish the fixed tabletop set, the light-bulb idea and the card stack under one warm key light.
visuals: Cool slate desk at dusk, warm practical key from upper left
Light bulb object flickers on in held exposures
Stack of five paper index cards beside the bulb
Empty felt pinboard with dark frame
Title and subtitle copy fade in

beats.development: Title fades in; bulb filament flickers to full glow on 15 fps exposures.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Cards take positions
scenes.purpose: Objects act as individuals: each card leaves the stack, hops with a tilt, lands with a contact shadow and settles into its place on the board.
visuals: Five cards hop one at a time, staggered and overlapping
Tilted mid-hop poses with moving shadows
Pins drop into each card after it lands

beats.development: Cards 1, 2 and 4 hop from the stack to the left and centre of the board; pins begin dropping.
Cards 3 and 5 make the longer hops to the right side; card 5 lands last near the bottom right.

scenes.title: Connected system
scenes.purpose: The last pin lands and threads finish linking every card, then the system holds still.
visuals: Thread tubes extend pin to pin across the board

beats.development: Card 5 settles and is pinned; the last three threads draw into it, completing the network.
Everything holds still: the five pinned, connected cards and the copy stay readable.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Hops are staggered 0.26 s apart and overlap, so the board fills in a readable order without everything moving together.
Longer hops (cards 3 and 5) get more time, scaled to their travel distance.
Poses change on 15 fps exposures for a held stop-motion cadence inside 30 fps delivery.
All motion settles by 2.62 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.62–3.0 s: settled hold so the completed system and copy can be read.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
Digital simulation of photographed object animation (Three.js render), not real photography.

Built from the reviewed source-frame lessons: object characters hop, tilt, land with contact shadows; fixed camera and single warm key light; colour comes from the materials. The source subject, lettering and branding were not copied.
STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes entries, so no extra named recipe is shown.
